title: SpaceCoin
tagline: An AI agent on Gaia monitors Twitter for new meme coins. When detected, it fetches the coin’s address, symbols, and price, then mints a pegged token on Arbitrum. Users can buy it, triggering a cross-chain process: USDC moves to Solana, swaps to SOL, and buys the meme coin.
description:
An AI system deployed on the Gaia platform. This system, built on Gaia Agent Kit, is designed to constantly monitor Twitter for any mentions of new meme coins. When it detects a relevant tweet, it immediately springs into action.
The AI's first task is to extract the meme coin's address from the tweet. It then uses this information to gather additional details about the coin, including its symbol and current market value. Armed with this data, the AI proceeds to mint a new token on the Arbitrum network. This new token is pegged to the value of the original meme coin, effectively creating a bridge between different blockchain ecosystems.
Here's where it gets interesting for users. They can now purchase these newly minted tokens directly on the Arbitrum network, known for its fast and cost-effective transactions. But the process doesn't stop there. When a user buys the token, it triggers a series of cross-chain interactions:
USDC (a popular stablecoin) is transferred from Arbitrum to the Solana blockchain.
Once on Solana, this USDC is swapped for SOL, Solana's native cryptocurrency.
The SOL is then used to purchase the original meme coin back on Arbitrum.
This entire process is automated, allowing for seamless interaction between different blockchains. It's designed to be user-friendly, enabling people to buy and sell meme coins regardless of their preferred blockchain platform.
The same mechanism works in reverse when selling the meme coin, ensuring liquidity and ease of use across multiple blockchain ecosystems. This innovative system not only broadens the adoption and liquidity of meme coins but also creates an integrated pathway for trading across diverse blockchain networks.
In essence, this technology is breaking down the barriers between different blockchain ecosystems, making the world of cryptocurrency more interconnected and accessible than ever before.
Also deployed on OpSec. We have also used Privy to connect wallets.
how_its_made:
Our project leveraged the Gaia Agent Starter Kit as a robust foundation, simplifying the integration of core components including our Foundry project for blockchain interactions. This framework streamlined the creation of the AI agent's infrastructure for Twitter monitoring, meme coin analysis, and cross-chain token operations1.
We deployed the application using OpSec, which provided an intuitive interface that significantly reduced setup time and allowed us to focus on core functionality. Privy's widget was seamlessly integrated to facilitate MetaMask wallet connections, enhancing the user experience for wallet management6.
While we encountered some initial challenges with Gaia node configuration, the process became more manageable once we overcame the learning curve4. Our approach to cross-chain token bridging, using custom scripts instead of off-the-shelf solutions, proved effective albeit somewhat unconventional.
The supportive communities behind Gaia, Privy, and OpSec were instrumental in our development process, offering timely assistance and insights that accelerated our progress. These partner technologies allowed us to concentrate on building the essential features of our cross-chain meme coin exchange efficiently.
